ns2:section.sectionText: This seminar will give you astrong understanding of global issues of immigration and integration through the case study of a particular region. You will investigate the social and political landscape of the Middle East, focusing on Jordan. This course draws from interdisciplinary materials and would be of particular interest to those pursuing majors in political science, anthropology, history, architecture and archeology.
